# Laravel Fatture in Cloud

> Laravel SDK for the Fatture in Cloud API v2 (Italian invoicing and e-invoicing platform). Composer package `offline-agency/laravel-fatture-in-cloud-v2`, MIT licensed, for PHP 8.4+ and Laravel 12/13. Create and send invoices, send electronic invoices (fattura elettronica) to SDI, and manage clients, suppliers, products, receipts, taxes (F24), archive, cashbook, price lists and webhooks.

Install with `composer require offline-agency/laravel-fatture-in-cloud-v2`, then set `FCV2_DEFAULT_ID` (company ID) and `FCV2_DEFAULT_BEARER` (access token) in `.env`, and check them with `php artisan fic:test-connection`.

Key facts:

- Access every API resource through the facade `OfflineAgency\LaravelFattureInCloudV2\LaravelFattureInCloudV2Facade`, e.g. `FIC::issuedDocuments()->all(IssuedDocumentType::Invoice)` or `FIC::clients()->create([...])`.
- Methods return a readonly, typed entity on success, an `Entities\Error` on API errors and an `Illuminate\Support\MessageBag` on local validation errors. They do not throw on API errors.
- `all()` follows pagination and returns every result; `list()` returns one page with pagination helpers.
- HTTP 429 rate limits are retried automatically using the `Retry-After` header, with a configurable cap. HTTP 403 is not retried.
- Multiple Fatture in Cloud companies are supported with `FIC::forCompany('name')`.
- Requests go through Laravel's HTTP client, so `Http::fake()` works in application tests.
- Ships Laravel Boost guidelines and an e-invoicing skill for AI coding assistants.
- Not the official SDK: Fatture in Cloud publishes `fattureincloud/fattureincloud-php-sdk`, a framework-agnostic SDK. This package is the Laravel integration.

- [Changelog](https://github.com/offline-agency/laravel-fatture-in-cloud-v2/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/offline-agency/laravel-fatture-in-cloud-v2/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): request lifecycle, retry flow, company resolution

## AI assistant resources

- [Laravel Boost guideline](https://github.com/offline-agency/laravel-fatture-in-cloud-v2/blob/main/resources/boost/guidelines/core.blade.php): rules for using the package correctly
- [E-invoicing skill](https://github.com/offline-agency/laravel-fatture-in-cloud-v2/blob/main/resources/boost/skills/fatture-in-cloud-e-invoicing/SKILL.md): create an invoice, preview totals, verify the XML, send it to SDI and track its status
